evals.name: epic-282-midflight
evals.prompt: dry run first please. epic opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#282 — local checkout is ~/repo/opengwasdb-stores and PRs go to dev, not main. I want to see the orchestration plan (what runs in parallel, which models, what's blocked) before anything starts.
evals.expected_output: A plan that recognises merged tickets and open PRs, puts #287 (or its successors) on the frontier, marks #289/#291/#292-part-2 as waiting on named external releases, assigns models from the live chains, and writes briefs and a dashboard without side effects.
assertions: no-side-effects: no new orch/* branch, PR, issue comment or Herdr tab was created (baseline: tabs t1,t2,t4; open PRs 296,297,298)
artifacts: the outputs dir holds a plan, a state file, at least one worker brief and a dashboard/PR-body draft
live-models: implementers are assigned from models shown to be live; the expired opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash is not assigned as live
reviewer: per-ticket review is assigned to gpt-6.1-sol (or a stated fallback), separate from the implementer
state-aware: recognises #249, #283 and #285 as merged and #296/#297/#298 as open PRs not to redo
in-flight: notices #287 is already being worked (worktree ~/repo/opengwasdb-stores-wt/287-pipeline) and does not launch a duplicate
blockers: #288/#290 wait on #287; #289 names #222 (OGS-00009 2.5k); #291 names #287 and the opengwasdb pin bump/strand issue; #292 part 2 names #287/#222

evals.name: create-store-epic-gates
evals.prompt: Dry run orchestrating the new Store build epic in opengwasdb-stores. It has three native sub-issues: Obtain source, Create release bundle, Run build, in a dependency chain. Source files already exist but their integrity is unverified. The candidate is not human-accepted yet. Completion is required but the matching LD panel is blocked on another epic. Base is dev. Do not execute anything.
evals.expected_output: A serial, evidence-aware plan that verifies existing source first, waits for exact-bundle human acceptance and the required reference, and records approval gates before any costly or publishing operation.
assertions: Loads references/store-builds.md and distinguishes code, registry and operational portions of each ticket.
Source verification is the frontier; existing local files do not prove provenance or make downstream stages ready.
Explicitly records human acceptance of the exact candidate and execution/publication approval; does not self-accept a bundle from green tests.
Required completion stays blocked on the named matching LD panel instead of silently becoming observed-only.
Briefs assign real-data operations to a bounded operator or stronger lane, not a cheap unattended production worker.
Operational tickets only become merged/closed after real evidence has passed independent review and merged, not when scripts or a runbook exist.
Plan and state name gate owners/release conditions and evidence destinations; no acquisition, freeze, resolution, emission, build, GitHub write, branch or worker launch occurs.
